item.title: Trump seeks to drop race question from census, history reviewed
item.description: The Trump administration aims to remove race and ethnicity questions from the next U.S. census, a topic used since 1790 to exclude people.

item.title: Congress debates college sports, former athlete senators involved
item.description: The Protect College Sports Act nears Senate passage, with former college athletes now serving as senators from both parties participating.
